summary: Voters in the Meerut city seat talk most about waterlogging, broken roads and jams in the old city during monsoon, with Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat and Meerut Metro starting in February 2026 as the main benefit people note.

positives.english: Metro and Namo Bharat trains have started in Meerut, so getting to Begumpul is easier now
positives.hindi: मेरठ में मेट्रो और नमो भारत चलने लगी, बेगमपुल तक आना अब आसान हुआ
positives.basis: Namo Bharat and Meerut Metro operations began in Meerut on 22 February 2026, with 4 Namo Bharat and 13 Metro stations in the city; Begumpul is named among the stations (district-level, Begumpul is inside Meerut city; AC membership of Begumpul not separately confirmed)

positives.english: Delhi to Meerut now takes about 55 minutes by Namo Bharat after the full stretch opened
positives.hindi: दिल्ली से मेरठ का सफर अब करीब 55 मिनट में होने लगा
positives.basis: PM inaugurated the full 82 km Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat stretch on 22 February 2026; the article says the full Delhi-Meerut journey will now take about 55 minutes (district-level)

positives.english: Begumpul now has a metro and Namo Bharat interchange, which saves commuters time
positives.hindi: बेगमपुल पर मेट्रो और नमो भारत की अदला-बदली की सुविधा मिली
positives.basis: Article states an interchange facility between Metro and RRTS at Meerut South, Shatabdi Nagar, Begumpul and Modipuram (district-level); Begumpul RRTS station is stated as operational since 22 February 2026 on Wikipedia

positives.english: All gates at Begumpul and Bhainsali metro stations have been opened, so crossing the road is shorter
positives.hindi: बेगमपुल और भैंसाली स्टेशन के सभी गेट खुले, सड़क पार करने का चक्कर कम हुआ
positives.basis: Article says all gates of Bhainsali and Begumpul stations have been opened, and earlier two Begumpul gates and one Bhainsali gate had stayed shut; no date printed on the page (URL indicates May 2026). Crossing-road benefit is a paraphrase of the opened gates, not a quote

positives.english: Metro timetable runs from Begumpul in both directions, giving people a regular ride option
positives.hindi: *बेगमपुल से दोनों दिशाओं में मेट्रो की नियमित सवारी मिलने लगी
positives.basis: Inference: the Amar Ujala article shows Begumpul in the Meerut Metro timetable for both directions; the source does not measure daily use or ridership. No delivered positive specific to AC 48 beyond transit was found in the sources reached

negatives.english: Lanes in old Lisari Gate and Begumpul get waterlogged in rain and drains fail
negatives.hindi: लिसाड़ी गेट और बेगमपुल की पुरानी गलियों में बारिश में पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: MLC Dharmendra Bhardwaj's press release (partisan, not independent reporting) says monsoon flooding left old-city lanes of Lisari Gate and Begumpul waterlogged, families bailed water from ground-floor rooms, and drainage failed in Lisari Gate; Begumpul and Lisari Gate are also named among seven chronic congestion crossings (district-level, claims not verified)

negatives.english: Record July rain turned roads into ponds and drain water entered homes
negatives.hindi: जुलाई की बारिश में सड़कें तालाब बन गईं, नाले का गंदा पानी घरों में घुसा
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala: 585.5 mm rain in July, a 22-year record, on 28 July 2026; 'सड़कें तालाब बन गईं, नालों का गंदा पानी घरों और अस्पतालों तक पहुंच गया'; roads and localities named include Begumpul Road, Delhi Road, Hapur Road, Kotwali, Ghantaghar, Sarafa Bazaar, Budhana Gate, Khandak Bazaar, Bhumiya ka Pul (city-level, district-level source)

negatives.english: Potholes and daily jams on Meerut roads make accidents a danger
negatives.hindi: मेरठ की सड़कों पर गड्ढे और रोज का जाम, हादसों का डर बना रहता है
negatives.basis: Article (October 2026, date from URL) says deep potholes and waterlogging make roads dangerous for two-wheelers, long queues at crossings, markets and busy routes, and repairs break up again quickly; no specific locality or assembly seat is named (city-level)

negatives.english: Fear that sealing will shut shops at Central Market and take away traders' livelihood
negatives.hindi: सेंट्रल मार्केट पर सील लगने का डर, दुकानदारों की रोजी-रोटी खतरे में
negatives.basis: India Today Hindi: Supreme Court order of 21 September 2026 expanded action from 44 to 16,726 properties in Zone-A; about 650 traders face rehabilitation pressure; the article places the market in Shastrinagar, Meerut, and does not name its assembly constituency (AC membership unconfirmed). Allegation/protest framing kept as reported

negatives.english: Fire in dense Kidwai Nagar lanes killed six of one family and worries people about safety
negatives.hindi: किदवई नगर की घनी बस्ती में आग, एक परिवार के छह लोगों की मौत से डर
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (24 Feb 2026): fire on 23 Feb at a textile trader's house in Kidwai Nagar Islamabad, Lisari Gate police station area, killed six members of one family; the report calls Rafiq Ansari the 'शहर विधायक' who visited the victims, which places Kidwai Nagar in the city seat by news report (AC-specific). 'Worries people' is a paraphrase, not a quote

notes: AC 48 is 'Meerut', the Meerut city seat, per the Wikipedia constituency list (AC 47 Meerut Cantt., AC 49 Meerut South). The Wikipedia constituency page gives no extent (wards/localities), so membership of each locality is not confirmed from an official boundary list. Rafiq Ansari (SP) is the 2022 winner (106,395 votes, 52.77%) and is called 'शहर विधायक' in Amar Ujala reports; the city-seat link for Kidwai Nagar rests on that. Shastrinagar Central Market: one Amar Ujala piece (7 April 2026) names Sardhana as an assembly seat, but the article text does not tie that to Shastrinagar, and the India Today piece names Cantt MLA Amit Agarwal, so the market's seat is unresolved and it is not counted as AC-specific. Begumpul and Lisari Gate are in Meerut city but their AC membership is not confirmed beyond the 'शहर विधायक' link. Sources for the July 2026 rain and the Oct 2026 roads piece are city-level; the Lisari Gate waterlogging claim comes from a partisan MLC press release and is unverified. Positive 5 is an inference, flagged with *. Searches for resident-level complaints inside the city seat and for completed AC-specific works (Lisari Gate, Begumpul, Ganga Nagar, Hashimpura roads and drains) returned little; several WARD-level news pages (Newstrack ward 21/22) could not be fetched (403), so they were not used. Amar Ujala 3 Oct 2026 women's demands were from Shiya Bagh Colony, Sardhana, not this AC, and were excluded. Field check needed: confirm the ward list and extent for AC 48 from the district election office, and find Hindi local-paper coverage (Dainik Jagran, Hindustan Meerut) of city-seat issues.
